# AK-512 -- Grace period after a failed renewal charge

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | implementation |
| Status | approved (2026-09-19, billing tech lead) |
| Work source | churn analysis: accounts lost to transient card declines |
| Integration owner | billing team |

## Goal

When a renewal charge fails, keep the account active for 72 hours after the
failed charge so the customer can update their card, instead of cutting
access the moment the paid period ends. Behind a configuration key,
`billing.gracePeriod`, off by default.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC-1** -- with `billing.gracePeriod` on, an account whose paid period has
  ended and whose last charge failed less than 72 hours ago is active.
- **AC-2** -- 72 hours or more after the failed charge it is not active.
- **AC-3** -- with `billing.gracePeriod` off, behaviour is unchanged.

## Allowed changes

- `src/billing/renewal.js`, `src/config/defaults.js`, `config/production.json`
- `test/billing/`
